artifacts.summary: The choice-free route to lem:state-set's three sentences, in two layers, with the absolute and relative axiom pins, the consumer audit, and the C16 gate-blindness finding.

completion_data.completion_summary: The paper's claim that lem:state-set's appeals to cor:occurrence, and hence to Zorn's lemma, are inessential to its applications now has a Lean counterpart: a new leaf module, FormalSystem/Metalogic/Independence/TranslationStateSet.lean, with seventeen declarations in two layers. The flow layer discharges (H1) and (H2) by exhibiting the witnessing world history outright as a translation over an arbitrary duration group, and its ten declarations carry no Classical.choice at all; the frame layer restates the same three sentences at translationFrame D with the witness written as the paper's own sigma_c, pinned relatively because #print axioms traverses a declaration's type and the frame constant's own choice is out of reach of any proof. StateSetTruth.lean's module docstring gained a four-route choice-dependence table and the consumer-audit verdict, which found every consumer already off the Zorn route, so none moved and DeterminismUndefinable.lean stays byte-identical.
